body: BUG-1197 round 4 is a no-op loop: the codex implementer re-read origin/bug-1197, saw round 3's commit (now ae8c6ad9d after the auto-rebase), reported the ROUND-3 items as "addressed and pushed", and ended phase 1 with zero new commits; the drain moved to review, which will RequestChanges on the same two parity items again. Please take round 4 yourself on branch bug-1197 (you have the repo context; drive mode, I review + ship): (1) one shared refusal-label function so MCP and CLI emit byte-identical text for the same operation (db_sync → "database writes", session_* → "session writes", role_* → "role writes", queue_* → "queue operations", add_relationship → "relationship writes", add_comment → "comment writes", update_requirement → "editing requirements", add_requirement → "adding requirements"); (2) a REAL parity test over (CLI argv, MCP tool) pairs asserting identical allow/refuse + identical text for guest and requester; (3) BUG-1211 folded in: the CLI requester add arm refuses --parent/--feature/--owner with the same text, one shared field const with mcp.rs, CLI test. Trailer (BUG-1197) (BUG-1211). When the drain shelves this round, do not re-drive it; push, ping me, I review from the diff and ship.
